text:
emma: Hey team — we need a compact set of launch assets for the benchmark webinar and inbound play. Main asks: micro-bench cards (social + sales), a simplified inbound-routing diagram for SDRs, and a 1-page sales one-pager. @liam can you own design?
liam: yep — I can own. Quick q: do we have final imagery or should I use the new abstract gradients?
olivia: use brand gradients but stick to the approved palette (v2). also need legal/brand-safe copy pass before anything goes external. tagging @sara for messaging variants. :white_check_mark:
sara: will provide three headline variants (technical, product, biz-value) + short desc per variant. i'll drop copy in the figma file by EOD Tue. :memo:
noah: for SDRs we need a PNG + SVG of the routing diagram and a simplified text-only export for outreach sequences. also include alt text for accessibility.
liam: noted. can you confirm target sizes? social 1200x628, card square 1200x1200, routing diagram 1600x900?
emma: yes to 1200x628 for hero cards, 1200x1200 for micro tiles, and routing as 1600x900. one-pager 8.5x11 (US letter) + PDF export. deadline: designs ready for review by 2026-04-05.
assets-bot: Uploaded starter frame -> https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/bench-inbound-kit (permissions: marketing-edit). auto-generated checklist below:
```
Asset,Size,Variants,Due
micro-bench-card,1200x628,EN/FR/DE,2026-04-05
micro-square-card,1200x1200,EN/FR,2026-04-05
routing-diagram,1600x900,EN only,2026-04-03
sales-onepager,8.5x11,EN/FR,2026-04-06
social-gifs,1200x628,EN/FR,2026-04-07
```
liam: sweet — i'll make 3 initial comps per asset (layout A/B/C) and include dev-friendly exports (SVG + optimized PNG + source .fig). I'll add notes for copy length limits.
olivia: reminder: include brand lockups and spacing rules. i'll do a quick brand QA pass on Wed. also run contrast check for buttons (AA).
sara: for A/B testing, sample CTAs: "Cut inference cost", "Ship faster LLM features", "Predictable inference economics" — i'll annotate preferred variants per audience.
noah: when assets are final can we get a flattened bundle + a link to a short Loom demo for SDR play? makes handoff smoother.
emma: yes — liam pls include a 1-min Loom showing how to use the routing diagram in outreach and which copy to pick per persona.
liam: will do. ETA for first draft: 2026-04-02 afternoon. :calendar:
emma: great — priority = high for webinar week. tagging all: please post final files in the figma project AND upload final zip to the marketing drive at /marketing/assets/benchkit-2026. i'll run legal/brand review on 4/6. :rocket:
assets-bot: Noted. I will auto-export final assets to drive when design marks frames as "ready for export".
